reviews.finding: Baseline main e35563b7f3d8ebf0acbbc80982b7bcf2e1b78c0a and exact-main CI run 1689 were verified as repository/CI evidence only.
File 25 remains the public visual/profile/timeline presentation owner without taking File 20 shell, File 21 publication, File 24 security or File 26 global search/ranking ownership.
File 03 focal_x/focal_y were parsed but discarded before rendering. Canonical owner focal metadata now reaches cover object-position; admin focal preset is fallback-only.
The plan-required brief introduction and truthful status-banner surface were incomplete. Hero now renders a bounded bio introduction and safe public lifecycle/status banner.
Desktop/mobile owner preview existed but the current central CV-021 RTL pre-publish preview was absent. Added authorized noindex RTL preview without widening data authorization.

The compatibility Timeline_Provider interface exposed only part of File 25 §46. Added an extended complete plan contract and implemented it in built-in File 21, WordPress fallback and portfolio adapters while preserving legacy compatibility.
Profile Timeline was effectively publication/post-only. Approved File 06 Knowledge, File 10 Video, File 11 Reels and File 12 PDF public projections now join the federated author timeline read-only.
Primary Timeline filters did not expose newly available Knowledge/Video/Reel/PDF types. Filters now appear only when their reviewed providers are enabled, available and registered.
Non-zero pin_weight had no mandatory actor/reason/reference/surface/start/end audit metadata and no expiry enforcement. Pins are now audited, time-bounded and internal metadata is redacted publicly.
File 21 remains canonical publication/ProfileTimeline owner; File 25 consumes its public query read-only and does not duplicate post state.
Portfolio adapters reuse reviewed public section projections, preserve normal 24-card section limits, allow bounded deeper timeline retrieval, and expose no native IDs through public card output.
File 08 remains clinic/appointment owner; File 25 does not infer a booking destination where no authoritative profile-to-booking contract exists.
File 17 remains relationships/messaging owner; Follow remains fail-closed without a target-bound owner contract and Message uses only a concrete owner-approved public destination.
File 20 remains structural shell/navigation/admin-parent owner; no second shell or layout backend was introduced.
File 24 retains security/privacy/compliance/resilience governance; File 25 changes remain presentation/read-projection scoped.
File 26 remains global search/discovery/ranking owner; new filters remain profile-local timeline presentation only.
Current File 07 main advanced to 1.2.1/DB 1.1.1/contract 1.2.1/projection schema 3; no File 25 code ownership conflict or direct dependency was introduced.
Current File 09 R26 main remains runtime 1.3.0/schema 6/integration contract 1.1.0 inside File 25's reviewed compatibility range.

Repository/dependency/staging/source documentation still pointed at Reviews 655-674 and older File 07/File 09 heads. Current source evidence is advanced through Reviews 675-694 without promoting staging/live truth.
All newly discovered File 25 source defects are corrected; Hostinger staging, deployed package parity, live DB/schema, migration and operational status remain external unverified gates.
